notes.title: ⚔️Illusion Lands DEVLOG #3⚔️
notes.content:
In devlog #3 you can see Attribute Affects
The prologue version👊 is coming soon⏳, so we continue to improve existing gameplay mechanics and work hard on new ones. In this video, you can see how the attribute effects system was implemented🆕

[previewyoutube=LJSzqfM6VNI;full][/previewyoutube]

Attribute effects - can be used when you manage to fill at least one segment of the attribute point bar.↗️ Depending on the selected attribute - the effect🪄 will be different. Each attribute has its own peculiarities, and their selection will depend on your chosen battle tactics💥. 


Attribute effects work regardless of which weapon🗡️ you are currently using. You can use any weapon⚡️.

In the future, the effects of this system will be used in other mechanics - skills, bombs, traps, and so on. This system will make the gameplay deeper and more interesting. Very soon you will be able to try this and much more on your own! ☄️

notes.title: ⚔️Illusion LandsPrologue: Defenders of Dune DEVLOG #2⚔️
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=kAi5hZ44gFI;full][/previewyoutube]
* the video was recorded from the game engine, so in the final game you can expect better quality

In devlog no 8🥳
you can see how the game looks at this stage of development, but that's not all that you have to try out in future releases. Soon we will add material with more complex gameplay and show more content.🪄


In this video you can see the use of several types of weapons 🏹🗡️ and unarmed combat system. In Illusion Lands, you can change weapons during combat 🔥without any restrictions. We tried to make the most dynamic 💫 and colorful gameplay.

You can use all types of weapons in combat⚡️ both on the ground and in the air☄️. During a successful dodge of enemy attacks, you can use a contractattack🔥 to knockdown the enemy💀

There are many tools in the game which you can use in gameplay e.g.- bombs💣, traps🪤, various consumable items. Some of them can be seen in this small snippet.

Of course, we will continue to develop ⬆️ the gameplay to make a lot of fun 😃 for you and interesting as possible 😎. 
Thanks for your support ! :)
